note: Circuit candidates: groups of nearby organizations that jointly fill the roles of a documented solution circuit. Derived, unverified - treat as introductions worth making, not existing partnerships.

circuits.name: Labor-for-housing pipeline
circuits.problem: Affordable homeownership without lifelong debt: land held in trust keeps homes permanently affordable, organized labor turns work-hours into equity, and cooperative finance bridges construction costs.

circuits.name: Local food security loop
circuits.problem: A local food system that survives supply shocks: growers produce, a cooperative channel distributes, and access organizations get food to people who cannot pay market prices.
circuits.evidence: data/taxonomy.yaml (Food and Nourishment; Local Food Systems; Food Sovereignty)

circuits.name: Housing justice pipeline
circuits.problem: Stopping displacement takes three capacities at once: tenants organized to resist eviction, legal capacity to fight cases, and a permanent- affordability vehicle to move buildings out of the speculative market.

circuits.name: Community health mesh
circuits.problem: Clinical care alone misses people; mutual aid alone lacks clinical capacity. A clinic, a neighborhood outreach network, and a health educator together form last-mile public health infrastructure.

circuits.name: Worker ownership transition
circuits.problem: When firms close or owners retire, jobs vanish. A union to organize the workforce, a cooperative developer to structure worker buyouts, and a trainer to reskill make business succession into worker ownership.

circuits.name: Land stewardship alliance
circuits.problem: Conservation without production becomes a museum; production without stewardship strips the land. A land-holding entity, an ecological steward, and a working farm together keep land healthy and in use.
circuits.evidence: data/taxonomy.yaml (Land Stewardship; Land Return [NEW_2026]; Regenerative Agriculture)

circuits.name: Food waste-to-soil loop
circuits.problem: Edible surplus feeds people, inedible surplus feeds soil, and gardens close the loop by growing more food. Requires rescue logistics, composting capacity, and growing space in the same city.
circuits.evidence: data/taxonomy.yaml (Composting; Recycling and Reuse; Community Gardens via Gardening)

circuits.name: Civic information commons
circuits.problem: Local news deserts starve local democracy. Community media, an education partner, and civic organizing groups can together rebuild a shared information base that residents actually use.
circuits.evidence: data/taxonomy.yaml (Open Source Journalism [NEW_2026]; Media; Democracy Education)

circuits.name: Cooperative development pipeline
circuits.problem: New co-ops fail alone: they need an apex body for peer support and standards, patient cooperative finance, and technical education. Together these form a regional co-op incubator.

circuits.name: Disaster resilience grid
circuits.problem: When infrastructure fails, response speed depends on relationships that already exist: neighborhood mutual aid for distribution, clinical capacity for care, and a coordinating body for logistics.

circuits.name: Community energy transition
circuits.problem: Energy bills drain neighborhoods; community-owned generation keeps the money local. Needs a generation co-op, finance for the capital cost, and a civic anchor to aggregate demand and host installations.

circuits.name: Eldercare commons
circuits.problem: Aging in place fails without three supports: cooperative or co-housing arrangements, day-to-day practical help, and accessible clinical care.
